meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 启用后自动生效:在会话开始和每次用户提交消息时注入项目说明;Codex 修改文件后注入匹配规则;还会把动态工具输出作为附加上下文注入并按会话去重,不会改写输出。
howto.when: 会话开始时和每次用户提交消息时自动注入静态项目说明;Codex 用 apply_patch 修改文件后注入匹配的文件规则。

say.text: Codex Rules 是怎么工作的？
say.note: 它会解释自动注入规则的行为。

say.text: 项目规则文件可以放在哪些位置？
say.note: 它会列出支持的项目源路径。

say.text: 怎样用环境变量控制或禁用 Codex Rules？
say.note: 它会说明 CODEX_RULES_* 等变量的作用。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, it auto-injects project instructions at session start and on user prompts, injects matching file rules after Codex apply_patch, and includes dynamic tool output as extra context (deduplicated per session) without changing it.
howto.when_en: Runs automatically at session start and on each user message for static instructions; after Codex applies a patch, matching file-related rules are injected.

say_en.note: It explains the automatic rule injection behavior.

say_en.text: Where can project rule files be placed?
say_en.note: It lists the supported project source locations.

say_en.text: How do I control or disable Codex Rules with env vars?
say_en.note: It explains CODEX_RULES_* and related variables.
